steps.title: Login screen — initial state
steps.notes: Assertion-only step confirming the initial login screen state, per flow/userLogin.md Step 1.

steps.title: Continue with password — password screen
steps.notes: Phone-number EditText has no content-desc/text of its own, so the '+91' country-code badge is used as the tap selector to focus it before typing. Entering the number before tapping 'Continue with password' is what pre-fills the phone-number field shown on the resulting password screen. Step 2 assertions no longer include 'Create new password' per current flow/userLogin.md (removed from doc).

steps.title: Successful login — Home page
steps.notes: Per flow/userLogin.md Step 3: 'user re-opens the password screen (back → Continue with password)' before entering the correct password. Live behavior requires TWO back presses here, not one: the password screen auto-focuses its (empty) password field with the keyboard shown, so the first back press only dismisses the keyboard (confirmed live: after 1 back, still on the password screen, password field empty+focused); the second back press is what actually navigates to the login screen, after which 'Continue with password' re-opens a fresh password screen with an empty, auto-focused password field. Added an explicit 'wait-for FasTag' (25s) action after tapping Login: confirmed live against Production that a genuine successful login can take longer than the built-in 10s screenMarker poll to actually navigate to Home (observed a transient 'Incorrect UserName or Password' label still present in the accessibility tree ~10s after tap, with Home/FasTag fully loaded moments later on manual recheck) — this explicit wait removes that false divergence without weakening the assertion itself. Post-login 'Unauthenticated App Detected'/notification-permission prompts (application/known-behaviors.md) are known non-blocking quirks, not asserted here.
